comparison.objective: Candidate calibrates and locks an angular gripper stop, then verifies repeatable motion; PR-1814 releases a hot air-fryer basket from hooks or a button-operated catch and transfers it to a heat-proof mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires two-tool countertorque and angular setpoint preservation; PR-1814 requires maintaining a release input during lifting or sliding clear of hooks, grasping a cool handle, collision avoidance, and controlled placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades opening accuracy, seated retained nuts, three-cycle drift, tool withdrawal, and clearance dwell; PR-1814 grades release actuation, basket clearance, on-mat pose, release/stillness, and permanent-zero hot-contact, bypass, or drop faults.
comparison.reason: PR-1814 tests keyed release and safe transport under hot-surface constraints, not coupled adjustment locking or cyclic setpoint retention. Its versions specify numeric release, placement, contact, drop, and dwell conditions; no material rubric detail is missing.
